description_en: Lists the subfolders or workflow drafts within a specified workflow draft folder

name: GetExperimentFolderChildren

parameters.description_en: The ID of the parent folder whose members you want to list. Set this parameter to root to specify the root directory.
parameters.description_zh: 要列出成员的父文件夹ID，假如是root表示是根目录。

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to list only folders.

parameters.name: only_folder

parameters.description_en:
The visibility within the workspace. Valid values:
- PRIVATE: Visible only to you and administrators in this workspace.
- PUBLIC: Visible to all users in this workspace.
parameters.description_zh:
工作空间可见性，可能值为：
- PRIVATE：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见。
- PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见。
